spec.headline: GTA 6'S FIRST WEEK IN |4 NUMBERS|
spec.topic: Weekly money scoreboard, GTA VI launch week. Rockstar/Take-Two 20 Nov: $3.79B worldwide retail sales and 32.5M copies through end of day 19 Nov (GamingBolt 21 Nov, PC Gamer, VideoCardz, Mixed). RDR2 first weekend $725M (GamingBolt; Take-Two 2018). 3.79/0.725 = 5.2x, our math. 8 Game Awards 2026 nominations (Gematsu 17 Nov, used 20b).

cards.note: RDR2: Oct 2018 · Take-Two · 5.2x is our math
